answer:
In the LlamaIndex starter tutorial, the save call is:

```python
index.storage_context.persist()
```

It writes to the default directory, **`./storage`**, relative to the current working directory. You can pass a different location explicitly with `index.storage_context.persist(persist_dir="...")`. The starter example later reloads the index from that directory with `StorageContext.from_defaults(persist_dir="./storage")` and `load_index_from_storage(...)`.

This is from my memory of the LlamaIndex docs, not from checking the code in your working directory, so verify against the version you have installed if the details matter.
